fusions.name: Puddle Pounce
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto the target and deal 16 water damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Belly-Flop Splash
fusions.desc: A splash that deals 30 water damage, ignoring armour, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves them [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Glanced Away
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you; transcendent damage still lands. You finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Damp Springs
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and you carry 8% water resistance.
